title: RoPE attention is an exact forward-pass gradient step with softmax intact
abstract: arXiv:2609.06685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We derive an exact gradient-step representation of the RoPE-softmax forward pass. For every deterministic RoPE-softmax attention head with arbitrary affine projection weights, we construct a query-dependent effective matrix $\Delta M_i$ satisfying $y_i = \mu_i + u_i^\top \Delta M_i$, where $\mu_i$ is the uniform mean of the attended values and $u_i$ is the augmented query input. The construction applies the classical exponential divided difference $\rho = \phi_1$ to retain the softmax exactly. Its positive coefficients give a unit gradient-step representation on a query-conditioned quadratic objective. The same function connects the RoPE generator to exact positional finite differences. We derive a tokenwise formula for the error of reusing one query's matrix and prove that a nonconstant finite-cache head cannot admit a globally exact affine query readout. Reconstruction checks and frozen-reuse calibration on one pretrained Qwen2.5-0.5

translated_title: RoPE 注意力是一个保持 softmax 完整的精确前向传播梯度步
translated_abstract: 我们推导出了 RoPE-softmax 前向传播的精确梯度步表示。对于每一个具有任意仿射投影权重的确定性 RoPE-softmax 注意力头，我们构造了一个依赖于查询的有效矩阵 $\Delta M_i$，满足 $y_i = \mu_i + u_i^\top \Delta M_i$，其中 $\mu_i$ 是被注意力值的均匀均值，$u_i$ 是增广的查询输入。该构造应用了经典的指数差商 $\rho = \phi_1$ 来精确保留 softmax 不变。其正系数给出了在查询条件化二次目标上的单位梯度步表示。同一个函数还将 RoPE 生成器与精确的位置有限差分联系起来。我们推导了复用单个查询矩阵的逐 token 误差公式，并证明了一个非常数的有限缓存注意力头不可能存在全局精确的仿射查询读出。在一个预训练的 Qwen2.5-0.5 模型上进行的重构检查和冻结复用校准
tldr: 本文证明了任意确定性 RoPE-softmax 注意力头的前向传播可以被精确表示为一个保持 softmax 的单步梯度更新，并给出了矩阵复用误差的逐 token 公式以及全局精确仿射查询读出的不可能性证明。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the forward pass of any deterministic RoPE-softmax attention head admits an exact single gradient-step representation with softmax intact, deriving a tokenwise reuse-error formula and an impossibility result for globally exact affine query readout.
